trigger: delegates test-running or build work to a subagent instead of using background processes
rule: Test suites and builds run synchronously. Never delegate them to a subagent — use background=true, notify_on_complete=true processes instead. Subagents are for reasoning work (< 30s budget), not waiting work.
source_correction: User pointed out I was unavailable for 9+ minutes because a subagent was stuck running test suites
